name: Inspect original Vilverin lower-room actors and select the learned spell through normal UI

files.content:
replace=config
replace=data
resources="{resources}"
data="{oblivion_data}"
content=Oblivion.esm
start=ImperialDungeon01
skip-menu=1
new-game=0
no-grab=1
user-data="{output}/userdata"
data-local="{output}/test-data"
content=tutorial-passage-observer.omwscripts

[Video]
resolution x = 640
resolution y = 360
fullscreen = false
framerate limit = 60
[General]
screenshot format = png

[Input]
enable controller = true

[GUI]
controller menus = true

[Input]
camera sensitivity = 0.5

local self=require('openmw.self')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local Actor=require('openmw.types').Actor
local camera=require('openmw.camera')
local util=require('openmw.util')
local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local t=0
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 t=t+dt;if t<.2 then return end;t=0
 local target=util.vector3(-4984,-4339,-1285)
 for _,a in ipairs(nearby.actors) do
  if a.id~=self.id and not Actor.isDead(a) then print('MeadFight actor='..a.id..' base='..a.recordId..' pos='..tostring(a.position)..' health='..Actor.stats.dynamic.health(a).current) end
 end
 local b=nearby.getObjectByFormId(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x6c362))
 if b and b:isValid() then print('MeadFight bottle pos='..tostring(b.position)..' bbox='..tostring(b:getBoundingBox().center)) end
 local p=camera.getViewTransform():apply(target)
 local a=math.atan2(p.x,-p.z)
 local e=-math.atan2(p.y,math.sqrt(p.x*p.x+p.z*p.z))
 print(string.format('VilverinTrap aim x=%d y=%d',math.max(-150,math.min(150,math.floor(a*256+.5))),math.max(-100,math.min(100,math.floor(e*256+.5)))))
 print('VilverinTrap sample pos='..tostring(self.position)..' health='..Actor.stats.dynamic.health(self).current..' dead='..tostring(Actor.isDead(self))..' paused='..tostring(core.isWorldPaused()))
 if self.position.y < -3300 then print('VilverinTrap beyond wire') end
 for _,id in ipairs({{0x6c362,0x6c363,0x6c364}}) do
  local o=nearby.getObjectByFormId(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',id))
  if o and o:isValid() then print('VilverinTrap original '..id..' pos='..tostring(o.position)) end
 end
end}}}}
